description:
A screenshot of the CLC+ Core User Admin/Support interface, displaying a "Data Catalogue" view on the left and a "Notifications" panel on the right.

The top header bar features navigation links: "Data Catalogue", "EAGLE Ontology", "About EAGLE", "Organisations", and "Users". On the far right, it shows a bell icon with a blue dot (indicating new notifications), a user profile icon, and the text "CLC+ Core User Admin/Support".

The "Data Catalogue" section includes filtering and search options: a "Filter" button, checkboxes for "My organisation/s", "My data", "Ingestions", and "Extractions", and a "Search" input field. Action buttons are prominent: "ADD INGESTION", "ADD EXTRACTION", and an icon for export or download. Below these controls is a table listing data entries with the following columns: "EAGLE Approved" (checkboxes are checked for all visible entries), "Name", "Type" (represented by a folder icon), "Created At", "Created By", "Country", "Region", "Reference Year", "Time Range", "Organisation/s", "Contact Person", and "Status" (with a downward arrow for sorting).
Three table rows are visible:
1.  **Name:** "CLC+Backbone (2018)", **Created At:** "05.09.2023", **Created By:** "CLC+ Core User Admi...", **Country:** "European Environ...", **Region:** "-", **Reference Year:** "2018", **Time Range:** "01.07.2017 - 30.06.2019", **Organisation/s:** "CLC, European En...", **Contact Person:** "copernicus@eea....", **Status:** "USED" (with a green checkmark icon).
2.  **Name:** "Coastal Zones (CZ) 20...", **Created At:** "21.06.2023", **Created By:** "CLC+ Core User Admi...", **Country:** "European Environ...", **Region:** "European Environ...", **Reference Year:** "2018", **Time Range:** "01.01.2017 - 31.12.2019", **Organisation/s:** "CLC, European En...", **Contact Person:** "info@eea.europa...", **Status:** "USED" (with a green checkmark icon).
3.  **Name:** "Corine Land Cover (CL...", **Created At:** "06.09.2023", **Created By:** "CLC+ Core User Admi...", **Country:** "European Environ...", **Region:** "-", **Reference Year:** "2018", **Time Range:** "01.01.2017 - 31.12.2018", **Organisation/s:** "CLC, European En...", **Contact Person:** "copernicus@eea....", **Status:** "USED" (with a red exclamation mark icon).

The right-hand panel, labeled "Notifications", can be closed with an 'x' icon. It contains a "MARK ALL AS READ" option with a green checkmark icon. The visible notifications are:
*   "Urban Atlas (UA) 2012 published." (indicated by a blue dot), received "Just now".
*   "UA_IBK_2018 processing finished." (indicated by a green checkmark icon), received "3 hours ago".
*   "UA_IBK_2018 processing cancelled." (indicated by a red exclamation mark icon), received "4 hours ago".
